_legend.cross_user: Cross-user evolution — mines pooled / multi-user interaction history into shared skills (platform flywheel, marketplace auto-distill). ★ = explicit; ◐ = partial; · = none.
_legend.user_isolation: Evolution user isolation — does NOT use other users' interaction history to generate shared skills. ★ = strong (single-user / session-scoped miner, or no auto miner); ◐ = partial; · = weak / N/A.
_legend.user_accounts: Multi-user account system in evolution path — auth / user_id scoping for decision logs & miners.
_legend.edge_evolution: Edge-side evolution — propose / patch / accept writes happen on local device FS (~/. or workspace/). ★ = all evolution local.
_legend.cloud_cross_device: Cloud cross-device evolution — auto skill patch/miner runs in cloud and syncs evolved skills across devices. · = none in all 8 repos.
